Freelance .NET / Umbraco Developer - Bristol

I'm Lewis Cooke, Bristol based freelance .NET developer specializing in Umbraco builds. I have over 15 years commerical experience building for the web. Tell me more...

I'm an experienced, conscientious .NET contractor with strong object oriented JavaScript skills. I'm comfortable working for big name clients and under tight deadlines. I believe in writing clean code and taking pride in the craft. No corners are cut, and code delivered is top quality.

As happy being sole dev on a project as being one of many in a team, I have delivered projects of all shapes and sizes from simple brochure style sites to complex multilingual, multi site builds with API integration and data capture.

The time I've spent working with agencies enables me to hit the ground running at any stage of a project. If you need someone to take a project from requirements gathering through specification writing, estimations and development through to completion, or whether you just need extra development resource to help you achieve a deadline, I can help.
